# Mr & Mrs Lifestyle

> Mr & Mrs Lifestyle is a Dubai-based personal training and online fitness coaching business run by husband-and-wife coaches Tarek Elzamek and Chloe Antoniazzi. They offer 1-to-1 personal training in Dubai and online coaching for clients in the UAE and worldwide, specialising in fat loss, muscle gain, body recomposition, women's glute training, pre/postnatal fitness and couples coaching.

Key facts:
- Location: Dubai, United Arab Emirates. In-person sessions at Nogs Gym (all clients) and The Pilates Room by Chloe, Meydan Avenue, Block A, Shop 3, Meydan (ladies only, private sessions, babies welcome, free parking; website thepilatesroombychloe.com).
- Coaches: Tarek Elzamek (strength and transformation specialist, 10+ years coaching) and Chloe Antoniazzi (women's, glutes and pre/postnatal specialist; mat, ball and reformer Pilates instructor).
- Online coaching prices: Economy Pack AED 299/month, Elite Coaching Experience AED 899/month, VIP Online Coaching AED 1,999/month, Couples Transformation AED 1,499/month. 12-week programmes from AED 480.
- 1-to-1 personal training in Dubai: Tarek offers 12 and 20-session packages at Nogs Gym; Chloe offers single sessions and 5, 10 and 20-session packages at The Pilates Room, Meydan (ladies only). Prices on request.
- Free strategy call before signing up. Contact: WhatsApp +971 50 787 1515, info@mrandmrslifestyle.com.

- [Personal Trainer in Dubai](https://www.mrandmrslifestyle.com/personal-trainer-dubai.html): 1-to-1 personal training in Dubai, locations, coaches and FAQ
- [Female Personal Trainer in Dubai](https://www.mrandmrslifestyle.com/female-personal-trainer-dubai.html): ladies-only private training, reformer Pilates and postnatal training with Chloe at The Pilates Room, Meydan (babies welcome, free parking)
- [Online Coaching](https://www.mrandmrslifestyle.com/online-coaching.html): how online coaching works, what's included, packages and FAQ
